notes.title: Anniversary Update 0.9.8400
notes.content:
- It's been a year since Gaiadon launched into Early Access, and I want to take a moment to thank every single one of you for playing the game. Your support and feedback have greatly helped shape the game. Here's to another year of adventures!
- New: Mythic Equipment, upgrade to Mythic equipment at Transcendence 45.
- New: Gems, Mythic equipment and above has 1 locked slot that you can unlock and slot gems, 40 new Gems, 4 new Gem Sets.
- New: Gem Dust, Gem Dust will start dropping at WT40 in No Man's Domain.
- New: Gemcutter, Gibzo the gilded has joined as a gemcutter, Gibzo can craft gems that you can equip on your mythic gear, 40 new recipes that unlocks as Gibzo levels up.
- New: In-game time added, 1 real sec = 60 in-game sec, the system currently tracks Lunar cycles and Seasons, Your total time spent before the update will be added to this stat.
- 1 New Pet, 1 New Projectile Cosmetic, 1 New Cosmetic type (Hero Avatar)
- Game save interval raised from 20 secs to 40 secs.
- Improved the save system and fixed existing issues, the game now keeps up to 5 days of backups instead of replacing the same daily_save file, and if both the main save and backup are corrupted, you'll be able to choose from the daily backups instead of doing a hard reset.
- Open upto 9.99m chests at a time.The new method is used only if your max chest open in setting is above 500. Below 500 it will loop through each chest.
- Hero and Pet corruption max level raised to 650.
- Apotheosis skill reset cost reduced to 3 Discipline Tokens.
- Onslaught Boss tier cap raised to 2000.
- A sealed letter now rests in your inventory.
- Medallion max level raised to 700.
- T Elixirs transcend animation will not play if Apotheosis has already been awakened.
- World's now have a max world tier, Aetheria, Eredurn and Frostheim max WT is 35, Incursion world max WT is 40, No Man's Domain max WT is 50.
- Setting for Hide Heroes has been split into 2, Hide Party members and Hide Main hero so you can keep just the hero if you want to.
- Added IP/Min to bottom info. It will show the incursion points accumulated last min.
- Added more data to export stats
- Kill a named enemy has been removed from daily quest pool.
- Loremaster level cap raised to 5000.
- Max Ascension Sacrifice raised to 375 and Max Transcendence Sacrifice raised to 75.
- Replaced Shikao's Resource Chance stat to Starting Level.
- Added Gold Crit. Chance to Pet sorting.
- Your last WT on a map will be remembered, so every time you come to that location, the WT will change to the last known WT.
- More optimizations on the splash kill lag, Your xp from kills is added to a pending pool and the system adds it to your character evey 0.5 secs. This has reduced the load on mass splash kill by almost 50%.
- Buy x 100 Button added for Festival Shop Consumables.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.9.4
notes.content:
Please take a backup before trying the update!
0.9.4 Patch Notes
New Additions

-Incursion (A61): A new game mode where four enemy factions from mysterious realms have descended upon Gaiadon. These enemies are invulnerable to your normal attacks. Build up your elemental damage to defeat them, starting at world tier 0.
-64 New Enemies/Pets: 16x Normal, 16x Fiend, 16x Demon, 16x Titan.
-New Character Info Screen: Now includes a full breakdown of the source of your stats.
-1 New Craftable Item
-Auto-Hunt Bosses: A new craftable item that lets you auto-hunt bosses from the Boss Hunt event. Once you manually defeat a boss at its highest possible tier, auto-hunt will automatically defeat them for you.
-Pet Loadouts: Create multiple loadouts that can auto-equip based on the content (Campaign Maps/Boss Hunt/Incursion Faction).
-Onslaught Boss Sweeps: You can now instantly sweep Onslaught bosses for any tier you’ve previously defeated, without starting a fight.
-Shop Update: Added a button to purchase a level's worth of cards from the shop.

Changes/Fixes
-Life Steal Adjustment: You can no longer steal more life than the damage you deal to an enemy.
-Slay Limitation: You cannot slay enemies that are more than 200k levels above your highest reached level. Slay does not work on Incursion enemies.
-Splash Crits: Splash damage will now also crit if your primary attack crits.
-Boss Hunt Update: Boss Hunt now correctly displays the current level and rewards when switching world tiers (previously, it showed the level based on the hero's world tier when the event reset).
-Frostheim Enemy Count Increase: Maximum possible enemy count (excluding world tier spawn bonuses) increased from 9 to 16.
-Reduced Fame Requirements: Early fame requirements have been reduced for Demons and Titans. Demons now max out at 4 kills, and Titans at 2 kills.
-Quest Adjustments: Pet level-up rewards have been removed from early fame quests.
-Corrupted Loom Fix: Fixed a bug that prevented items from appearing in the Corrupted Loom item selector list.
-Equipment Max Level Increase: Normal, Uncommon, Rare, and Epic equipment max levels have been increased to 2k, 4k, 8k, and 15k respectively.
-Active Pet Buffs: Active pet stats have been buffed.
-WT10+/1M Levels+ Scaling Removal: Extra enemy HP scaling has been removed for WT10+/1M levels+ enemies. This change will be adjusted based on feedback.
-Nexus Update: Coinforge has been replaced with another Nexus; only one Nexus needs to be leveled.
-Transcendence Buff: The stat bonus from Transcendence now improves with every Transcendence.
-Transcendence Cap Increase: Transcendence cap raised to 15.
-Dorian Graybone Cap Increase: Dorian Graybone’s level cap has been raised to 300—because 300 is a cool number.
-Medallion Max Level Increase: Medallion max level has been raised to 200.

Consider leaving a review if you liked the game.

notes.title: Update 10 - 0.9.1 EA
notes.content:
[b]What's New[/b]
 - New Feature: Crafting, The first crafter added.
 - New Feature: Onslaught, Defeat and advance through boss tiers.
 - New Medallion: the second medallion has been added.
 - New: Legendary Gear, legendary gear max level is tied to your Transcendence level.
 - New: Synergy Surge for legendary gear.
 - New: Treasure chests - Defeated enemies has a small chance to drop a treasure chest. they can drop gold, crafting mats, pet card and unique resources.
 - New items in quest shop (once blacksmith is unlocked).
 - 17 New resources/items.
 - 6 New Fame Levels.
 - 2 New Heroes.
 - 2 New Bosses/Pets.
 - 1 new skill book (Crafted).

[b]Changes[/b]
 - Medallions can be crafted to uncommon.
 - Thron Stoneforge gold bonus has been changed to Loom Bonus.
 - There’s a slight boost to the drop chance for maps and world resources the further you farm, including within world tiers (these are crafting resources).
 - Treasure chests are part of the world tier loot table, and their drop chance increases slightly as you progress to higher tiers.
 - Bosses drop more tokens as the world tier increases.
 - Character has a max level now, its based on the highest ascension reached.
 - Equipment and shops have a x1000 multiplier.
 - Corrupted Nexus, Coinforge and loom frame size increased eliminating the scrollbars.
 - Every 3rd world tier will increase the monster density by 1.
 - Enemies get attack and HP boost from world tier 10 and lvl 1mil onwards.
 - Export dialog now adds a default file name Gaiadon_dd/MM/yyyy_time.bin.
 - When Esc menu is on and save is selected, the menu stays on.
 - World tier can now be selected from the main game screen, also map navigation buttons have been added to the main screen.
 - Corrupted Loom, harness, bond and shops now shows an indicator if the pet/hero is active.
 - Onslaught bosses will not have the corrupted affix.
 - Transcendence cap is now 7.
 - Medallion max level changed to 175.
 - crafter's max level is 1500.
 - Pets/Heroes max corruption level is 300.
 - Max rage level is now 85.

[b]Fixes[/b]
 - Fixed a bug where fame hero stats were not getting reset after unequipping them.
 - Fixed incorrect level display (visual bug) for dorian graybone after reaching max level.
 - Fixed an issue where tooltips wont switch to the left side when on 1440p and above resolutions.
 - Fixed Synergy levels not correctly updating.
 - Transcend now applies bonus to corrupted domain without needing a game reboot.

Please backup your save files before trying the update.
